name: math30_mathglm
description: The `math30` profile with the arithmetic budget split between two corpora that teach different things. `mathglm` (6%) supplies compositional depth: 1 to 12 chained operations under operator precedence, and multiplication that is 66.9% four-digit by four-digit. `math_drills` (4%) supplies the algorithm underneath it -- MathGLM resolves each atomic operation in a single jump, so nothing in it shows how a product is formed, while the v3 drills decompose every multiplication into single-digit column facts with carries. The audited v2 corpus had the opposite gap: every drill was one operation, the multiplier was always strictly narrower than the multiplicand so no equal-width product existed anywhere, and multiplication scored 0% at every digit width against 95.8% for column-decomposed four-digit addition. The extra 4% is paid out of `deepmind_math`, which drops from 5% to 2% because generated arithmetic is precisely the role `mathglm` now fills at greater scale and depth, and out of `open_web_math` by one point. `openmath_instruct` is held at 8%: it is the only source carrying word problems with worked solutions, which is the capability the arithmetic corpora feed rather than replace.
